content.title: About
content.content: Spaghetti and meatballs dinner is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal produced by NFS. The package contains spaghetti, a seasoned tomato sauce, and meatballs made from beef and pork. It is designed for quick preparation in a microwave or on the stovetop in 5‑7 minutes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is based on the classic Italian-American spaghetti‑and‑meatballs recipe popular since the mid‑20th century.
Meatballs are a 70/30 blend of beef to pork, providing juiciness and a rich flavor.
The tomato sauce is made from ripe tomatoes, onion, garlic and basil, without artificial coloring.
The frozen product has been tested to retain pasta texture after microwave reheating.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, meeting NFS’s sustainability standards.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: The meatballs deliver about 12 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Beef provides heme iron, which is more readily absorbed than plant‑based iron.

items.title: Tomato sauce – source of lycopene
items.content: Lycopene is an antioxidant that supports heart health.

items.title: Carbohydrates for energy
items.content: Spaghetti supplies complex carbs that provide sustained energy and satiety.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: The meal contains no added sugars, making it suitable for moderate sugar intake.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Spaghetti is made from wheat, so the product is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The sauce may contain trace dairy ingredients; check the label if you have a dairy allergy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The tomato sauce provides about 500 mg of sodium per serving; individuals monitoring salt intake should account for this.

items.title: Requires thorough heating
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave the product unsafe; follow the recommended time and temperature.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the package in the microwave (or on the stovetop) according to the instructions, stir, and serve hot. Optional toppings include grated Parmesan, fresh basil, or vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen meal at –18 °C or lower. Once the package is opened, consume within 24 hours and store in the refrigerator.
